Sports.title: Manchester United’s infamous 1974 relegation is a warning from history
Sports.summary: It may have been a different era, but the 1970s contain salutary lessons for a club in serious decline once again In many ways, there are striking parallels between the Manchester United relegated in 1974 and the Manchester United sitting in the relegation zone at this stage of the season for the first time in 40 years. A legendary manager leaves, his shadow remains; with boardroom dithering and uncertainty, his replacements churn and burn as the club slide over several years. Sir Matt Busby stepped aside as manager of the 1968 European Cup-winning side, but stayed on as a director, just as Sir Alex Ferguson did, watching from the Old Trafford directors’ box as successors tried and failed. Sports.title: MLB commissioner Manfred cites fan support for salary cap as baseball heads towards lockout
Sports.summary: 2027 season under threat amid dispute over salary cap Commissioner says fans want a more equal game MLB commissioner, Rob Manfred, has insisted owners will not budge from their demand for a salary cap , leaving the league on track for a lockout starting 2 December that could threaten the 2027 season. “I can’t imagine the owners ratifying a deal that does not include a cap and floor,” Manfred said on Wednesday at a news conference during an owners meeting. Players say they will never accept a cap. The last time management proposed a cap in 1994, it led to a strike that lasted almost eight months and caused the cancellation of the World Series for the first time in 90 years.
